added.description:
About Us

Parabola is a workflow builder that makes it easy to organize and transform messy data from anywhere—even PDFs, emails, and spreadsheets—so that forward-thinking teams can automate the work they thought would always be manual.

Teams at fast-moving companies like Brooklinen, On Running, and Flexport use Parabola to save hundreds of hours and finally take on the projects that used to feel out of reach. Whether it’s reconciling inventory across multiple 3PLs, auditing invoices, or manually exporting the same report every Monday, Parabola gives teams the power to automate it—all without needing engineering support.

Parabola is backed by OpenView Partners, Matrix Partners, Thrive Capital and more.

About The Role

The Applied AI team at Parabola is the conduit through which our largest and most strategic accounts pass through on their way to unlocking the maximum value from our product.

As an Automation Engineer on our Growth team, you will be directly responsible for partnering with key accounts post implementation to ensure value realization continues throughout their lifecycle.

Your mission is to drive sustained adoption, expansion of use cases, and measurable business impact across complex organizations. You’ll proactively monitor account usage and engagement signals, identify opportunities to deepen value, and work directly with customers to design and deploy new workflows that solve evolving business challenges.

You’ll serve as a trusted partner to both technical and business stakeholders, ranging from the C-Suite to the analyst, for QBRs, workshops and building sessions.

You will own customer strategy, technical execution, stakeholder alignment, commercial renewals, and long-term success. You’ll make sure that your portfolio of growing customers continue to see Parabola as a core part of their operations.

You’ll lead with data, move fast, and operate comfortably in ambiguity while shaping how we support our most customers. You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Sales to solve customer problems and help shape what we build next.

About You

You love customers and are naturally curious about how their businesses truly work. You enjoy learning the ins and outs of their organizations, mapping company level goals to functional outcomes, and helping teams leverage automation to accelerate meaningful results.

You’re energized by meeting new teams, uncovering new use cases, learning new systems, and turning ideas into deployed, repeatable solutions. Along the way, you naturally build playbooks and best practices that scale across accounts.

You’re equally comfortable facilitating strategic conversations with senior leaders and getting your hands dirty technically. You can present confidently to executives, lead collaborative workshops, and seamlessly transition into working with APIs, prompting the latest AI models, and bringing Parabola flows to life.

You’re skilled at managing multiple initiatives at once, creating clear project plans, and maintaining momentum in complex customer environments.

Above all, you are a trusted advisor that is thoughtful, confident, and personable. You represent Parabola professionally, advocate for the customers you support, and take ownership of ensuring they continue to realize and expand value with our product.

What You'll Be Doing

Own post-implementation relationships for ~15-30 Mid-Market accounts, serving as a trusted advisor from executive sponsors to hands-on operators
Monitor and analyze product usage and engagement metrics to assess account health, identify risk, and surface expansion opportunities
Partner with customer stakeholders to map organizational goals to functional initiatives and high-impact automation use cases
Adapt your approach and be able to effectively context switch across the range of personas we serve, and tailor each conversation to what matters most to them
Quantify the value and ROI customers get from Parabola, and build frameworks to measure it consistently across your portfolio
Design, build, and deploy new workflows alongside customers, supporting end users through hands-on co-building and technical guidance
Lead QBRs, trainings, lunch-and-learns, and workshops
Develop and refine repeatable playbooks and best practices to drive sustained adoption across mature accounts
Build and maintain plans, timelines, enablement materials, and executive-facing presentations
Drive non-upsell renewals from start to close, handling proposals, negotiations, and the contracting process
Partner with Account Executives and internal Product/ Engineering teams to identify upsell opportunities, and surface actionable product feedback

What (we Think) You'll Need To Do It

2-5 years of experience in a customer-facing role, such as Technical Account Management, Technical Customer Success, Implementation Consulting, or Sales Engineering
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to quickly build trust and rapport across a wide range of stakeholders
Polished presentation and facilitation skills, including comfort presenting to executive audiences
Strong prioritization skills so you can focus your time where it will have the greatest impact within your book of business
Experienced in quantifying ROI and building business cases that clearly communicate impact and value to executive stakeholders
Comfort and familiarity with prompting modern AI models and applying them in real-world business contexts
Experience working with data and systems (Excel, SQL, and with APIs)
Strong problem-solving skills, with a passion for breaking down complex challenges and designing effective solutions across industries
High ownership and intellectual curiosity with the ability to ramp rapidly in new industries, systems, and workflows
Based in San Francisco or New York City, with the ability to commute to the office 3–4 days per week

Nice To Haves

Previous experience working with AI tools
Previous experience working with ERPs, WMSs, TMSs (NetSuite, Uber Freight TMS, Microsoft Business Central, Blue Yonder)
Experience working in a project based role - i.e. consulting
Knowledge of supply chain fundamentals or finance/accounting
Previous experience working in a start up environment

OTE Range: $130,000 - $165,000

This OTE represents the minimum and maximum for this role based in San Francisco and New York. The salary given for this position is dependent on multiple factors, including years of experience, interview performance and anticipated responsibilities of the role. Our base salary is one component of Parabola’s competitive total package, which also includes equity and premium health and wellness benefits.

Description

Tyndall Federal Credit Union is an established Credit Union based in Panama City, Florida with branches across the Florida Panhandle and South Alabama. We offer our employees a family-orientated work environment with numerous exciting benefits and career growth. We are looking for the next member of our #TeamTyndall family!

Our Mission

Tyndall Federal Credit Union is committed to making a meaningful difference in the lives of our members. We take pride in the great care we offer our members and employees alike!

Our Credit Union serves more than 100,000 members.
We believe in helping our members reach their financial goals and making dreams come true along the way!
We believe having a diverse workforce yields greater innovation, inclusion, and creativity.
Tyndall Federal Credit Union knows the importance of philanthropy in our communities. That’s why in addition to giving back through community service grants and sponsorship, we encourage our employees to volunteer in their community – and get paid while they’re doing it!

Benefits:

Family First Leave- Providing 12 weeks of 100% paid bonding time to all Full Time Eligible employees.
We offer an excellent 401(k) plan with generous employer matching.
All employees receive 16 paid community volunteer hours.
Full Time (up to 40 hours per week) positions also offer 11 paid holidays, paid time off, excellent health/vision/dental benefits and more!
Part Time (up to 35 hours per week) positions are offered 11 paid holidays, and paid time off!

The Location:
Tyndall Federal Credit Union is based in Panama City, Florida. This position is a remote opportunity; however, we have a strong preference for candidates who reside within one hour of our Operations Center (3109 Minnesota Ave, Panama City, FL 32405).

Why Should You Apply?
Tyndall Federal Credit Union offers an exceptional employee experience that includes comprehensive benefits, a culture of appreciation, flexibility, a family-oriented atmosphere, and rewarding work.

Role

Manage the full lifecycle of the credit union's core banking environment, including the development, testing, and deployment of program updates, reporting extracts, and automated job schedules. Coordinate core releases by balancing technical deployment with guiding operational teams through process changes, including documentation updates, communicating staff training needs, and process optimization. Build and maintain secure, efficient interfaces with third-party partners, such as mobile banking and credit reporting services, to automate workflows which reduce both manual work and additional back-office tasks. Serve as a departmental leader and technical escalation point, providing mentorship on programming, projects, and stepping in for the Director of Core Systems as needed. Prioritize system uptime since even minor bugs in core banking code can have significant operational and financial repercussions for the credit union and our members. Ensure the core banking system is fully compliant with financial regulations through robust audit trails, data and backup encryption, and strict access controls. Demonstrating and upholding our Core Values and WE Standards is a fundamental responsibility of every employee and is required in all positions throughout the organization.

Essential Functions & Responsibilities

Develop and maintain robust application software by writing clean, efficient, and well-documented code in our core programming languages. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate these solutions with credit union systems, ensuring high performance, scalability, and strict adherence to financial security standards.
Analyze, develop, and test new processes as well as modify existing processes. Automate manual processes and tasks whenever possible. Develop and maintain credit union data processing schedules including assuring documentation is updated and modified as required.
Coordinates the installation of core system software releases, patches, and updates. Assists in pre-testing and implementation of core system software.
Maintains an up-to-date working knowledge of core system software, keeping abreast of the capabilities of the system with each new release. Coordinates with the software vendor(s) and analyst teammates on implementation, configuration, and interface builds related to core banking software and hardware.
Ensures high availability, redundancy, and recoverability of the core banking systems. Monitors resources of the core system in terms of disk space and allocation, memory usage, processor usage, and end-user response-time. Makes proactive recommendations to supervisor regarding system upgrade requirements.
Assures that all core system software and hardware problems are resolved in a timely manner. Maintains up-to-date documentation of all system issues. Provides general support for other technology or data processing issues related to core banking.
Manages projects ensuring project deliverables are provided on time with a high level of quality and accuracy.
Provides technical training and mentorship for fellow teammates, developing their technical skill sets. Keep communication with colleagues and peers within IT and across the organization clear and professional.
Ensure compliance with all regulatory programs including but not limited to the Bank Secrecy Act, Office of Foreign Asset Control Program and Customer Identification Program. Assist other department personnel and performs other duties as assigned. Remote employees must adhere to their agreed-upon work schedule from a secure location, participating in virtual meetings, video conferences/other communications, and maintaining regular, responsive communication during working hours. Demonstrate flexibility to work varied hours as needed, including evenings and weekends, to support system coverage and departmental needs, including coverage during employee absences, training periods, or equipment issues.

Performance Measurements

Demonstrates proficiency in core banking programming and scripting languages by delivering accurate and efficient code solutions for core banking applications.
Develops, implements, and optimizes processes for automation and workflow improvements, resulting in increased operational efficiency and reduced manual intervention. Comprehensive expertise in managing the core banking job schedular so that no business process is interrupted. Complete assigned period end processing and reports on schedule, with zero errors.
Coordinates software releases for core system applications, performing thorough testing and validation to ensure timely, error-free deployments in accordance with release schedules.
Maintains up-to-date knowledge of core system software, effectively collaborating with vendors to address issues and facilitate enhancements.
Monitors system availability and performance metrics, proactively identifying and resolving resource bottlenecks to ensure continuous, high-quality service delivery. Keep management informed of service interruptions and minimize downtime to off-peak time hours.
Resolves complex software and hardware issues promptly, documenting actions and outcomes to build a knowledge base and support future troubleshooting efforts.
Manages projects by adhering to defined timelines, budgets, and quality standards, ensuring that all deliverables meet business and regulatory requirements.
Provides technical training, guidance, and mentorship to colleagues, enhancing team capabilities and supporting ongoing professional development.
Act as a reliable bridge between IT and non-technical departments, demonstrating success by simplifying complex findings into clear, actionable guidance that supports informed decision-making. Exhibit intentional communication style by prioritizing clarity, brevity, and structured formatting to ensure your key messages are easily understood and respected by peers throughout the credit union.
Provide friendly, professional and accurate service and support to all members and associates Ensure staff interactions are built upon trust, integrity, patience, and respect.

This Job Description is not a complete statement of all duties and responsibilities comprising the position.

Requirements

Experience:

Five years to eight years of similar or related experience.

Education

(1) A two-year college degree, or (2) completion of a specialized certification or licensing, or (3) completion of specialized training courses conducted by vendors, or (4) job-specific skills acquired through an apprenticeship program.

Interpersonal Skills

Work involves much personal contact with others inside and/or outside the organization for the purpose of first-level conflict resolution, building relationships, and soliciting cooperation. Discussions involve a higher degree of confidentiality and discretion, requiring diplomacy and tact in communication.

Other Skills

Able to create simple PC-based software applications and reports. Ability to type, use computer and general office equipment including 10-key calculator. Requires basic to intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Windows, Word, Outlook and Excel. Knowledge of Summit Spectrum Back-Office Operations is preferred. The ability to travel locally and out of town on credit union related business and training may be required. Understanding of database administration concepts to include working knowledge of UNIX and Windows.

Physical Requirements

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands, and is required to talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to stand, sit, and walk occasionally for long periods at a time. The employee may occasionally be required to reach with hands and arms and move objects up to 20 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, and ability to adjust focus. In addition, abilities for assessing the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned is required.

Maintains platform documentation, technical standards, design records, data maps, runbooks, test evidence, and knowledge articles; communicate risks, impacts, decisions, and progress in clear business and technical language.
Mentors associate practitioners, participates in peer reviews and agile ceremonies, and contributes to the platform roadmap, backlog, governance, adoption, and continual-improvement priorities.

Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to perform the essential functions of the job.
Minimum of four years of progressive experience in enterprise platform engineering, ServiceNow development or administration, workflow automation, application development, systems integration, IT service management, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience configuring and supporting enterprise service-management capabilities such as incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, service catalog, configuration, asset, or service-level management.
Experience with scripting, APIs, integrations, data imports, workflow design, testing, release management, platform security, reporting, and production support.
Strong knowledge of enterprise service-management platform architecture, configuration, workflow automation, data models, security, integrations, reporting, and lifecycle practices.
Proficiency with scripting, APIs, integration patterns, data transformation, debugging, source control, testing, and repeatable deployment practices.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and systems-thinking skills, with the ability to identify root causes and design sustainable platform solutions.
Working knowledge of IT service management processes, configuration-management information, service modeling, change controls, cybersecurity, and operational resilience.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate technical concepts, options, risks, and impacts for different audiences.

Ability to collaborate effectively, manage multiple priorities, and influence outcomes without relying on formal authority.
